text:
maya: Heads-up — after the int8 bring-up on q4b, we've got a spike in hallucination for long-code prompts (>1024 tokens). Not huge overall, but consistent failures on the same prompt families.
ben: ugh. Is this from kernel quant mismatch or KV cache truncation?
maya: initial triage suggests subtle token misalignment in long-prefix attention state. Happens only on int8 float-mapped kernels, float16 looks fine.
sophia: can you paste a failing example?
maya: sure — short anonymized snippet below (removed customer data):
```
# prompt (trimmed)
# long system + code context (~1.3k tokens)
def generate_report(data):
    # expected -> structured json with table rows
    ...
```
maya: model output instead was a confident but incorrect summary and then invented column names.
alex: that's worrying for codegen SLAs. Do we have eval metrics across canaries or just a few repros?
maya: we ran the standard longctx golden (200 prompts) vs float16 and int8:
```
float16: pass@1 78%, hallucination-rate 4.2%
int8:   pass@1 67%, hallucination-rate 12.8%
```
maya: failure modes cluster around long table synthesis and multi-file context.
eli: any perf tradeoff numbers? If we revert to f16, throughput down ~18%?
ben: int8 gave ~2.4x throughput on these GPUs for batched bursts. Reverting will hurt cost.
sophia: we should gate int8 on a routing policy: short prompts -> int8, long prompts -> f16. Quick fix while we investigate.
maya: agreed. Can infra do route-by-context-length? ops-bot: @eng-infra new routing rule request: route requests with input_tokens>1024 to model:q_f16_v3, else model:q_int8_v3. Priority: high.
ops-bot: task created: INFRA-1289. ETA for rollout canary: ~2h (need config + test).
labeler-bot: Need golden set expansion for the long-context code cluster — current golden has only 40 long code samples. Recommend +200 canary long-code prompts with focused expected outputs.
ben: @labeler-bot +1. Labelers might need special instructions (table schemas, expected column ordering).
eli: who can own the golden expansion? alex: I can coordinate labeler batches and write instructions.
alex: proposed plan: (1) lock current int8 rollout, (2) route longctx to f16 canary, (3) push expanded golden (200 new samples) into eval harness, (4) run int8 vs f16 A/B on that set and collect diffs.
sophia: add a regression severity score per sample (0-3): 0=ok,1=minor formatting,2=incorrect content,3=hallucinated facts/code). We'll treat 3s as immediate blockers.
maya: good call. Also add a tag field for "multi-file" vs "table-synth" so we can triage by pattern.
alex: labeler instructions draft (short):
- For each prompt, run both models and paste outputs.
- Mark severity 0-3.
- If severity>=2, add a short note about why (e.g., missing column X, wrong aggregation, invented field).
- If PII or sensitive, mark redacted and skip.

alex: I'll drop the instructions into the labeler queue now. Labeler-bot, can you create a 200-sample batch, priority high?
labeler-bot: Created batch LBL-4098 (200 long-code prompts). ETA for completion: 3 business days (we can do an accelerated 48h pass if we assign more reviewers).
ben: while labelers work, can we test a narrow patch: change KV cache alignment padding in int8 kernel. Might be a quick fix. Maya, can you /provide a test harness?
maya: yes, I'll instrument a mini-bench that replays failing traces and toggles the padding option. Expect results in ~6h.
eli: also add a logging flag to capture token-level attention maps for a few repro cases — privacy redacted.
maya: will do.
sophia: for immediate production risk: set routing rule + add alert if hallucination-rate on longctx canary >8% over 1h. ops-bot: alert rule AR-901 added.
ben: long-term, we should update the quant profile for these kernels — maybe per-layer symmetric vs asymmetric quantization change. I'll schedule a follow-up with research next week.
maya: thanks all. I'll post an interim update when the mini-bench completes. If labeler results show many severity=3, we'll rollback int8 for all code-gen routes until it's fixed.
eli: ping me if you need extra lab GPUs for debug traces.
alex: tagging @sophia for product implications — we may need to notify some customers if we rollback.
sophia: got it. Prep notice draft if we hit rollback.
maya: interim: routing rule live in canary in 15m. Will monitor.
ben: :thumbsup:
labeler-bot: LBL-4098 assigned to team 'golden-ops', sprint tag 'urgent'.
ops-bot: INFRA-1289 rolled to canary. Traffic routing verified.
maya: canary metrics so far (first 30m): longctx error-rate down 75% on production traffic to canary f16. Int8 overall latency lower, but quality gap persists.
maya: update coming after the bench (6h).
